name: Next.js real-time video streaming: HLS.js and alternatives
snippet: Set up real-time video streaming in Next.js using HLS.js and alternatives, exploring integration, adaptive streaming, and token-based authentication.

name: How to Stream IP Cameras to a Website (RTSP → HLS, WebRTC
snippet: This guide covers the three practical methods for getting a live camera feed into a webpage: HLS (maximum compatibility), WebRTC (minimum latency), and RTMP to a streaming platform (for public broadcasts). For each method, you'll see real working code.

name: WebRTC vs HLS: Choosing the Right Streaming Protocol
snippet: Compare WebRTC and HLS across latency, scalability, device support, and use cases. Learn when to use each protocol — or both — for your streaming app.

name: Building a Real-Time Video Streaming Server with RTMP, WebRTC
snippet: Protocol babel-fish: Seamlessly converts RTMP ↔ WebRTC ↔ SRT ↔ HLS so you can ingest from OBS and reach mobile Safari, Chrome, or a set-top box without re-encoding. Cloud-native DNA: Docker image, Helm charts, Prometheus exporter, and graceful reload via ConfigMap.

name: Simple peer-to-peer with PeerJS | PeerJS
snippet: PeerJS simplifies WebRTC peer-to-peer data, video, and audio calls. Connect browsers directly with a few lines of JavaScript.
